newsitem.title: USA: Lufkin sees improvement after disappointing Q1 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Lufkin sees improvement after disappointing Q1 EPS.

text.p: Lufkin Industries Inc said Monday that while results for the first quarter were below its earlier expectations, it is optimistic that results for the balance of 1997 will build upon the success it has had already in improving operations, controlling costs and developing new products over the last few years.
The company reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.23 per share, compared with $0.36 per share, in the first quarter last year.

The company said the decline in net earnings was primarily a result of an unfavorable product mix in power transmission products toward slow speed gear products, which typically carry lower margins. The company added that the product mix in power transmission did show improvement in March from January and February levels, and net earnings showed improvement on a monthly basis throughout the quarter.
The company also said its backlog at March 31 was $101.2 million, the highest level since December 31, 1995.
Lufkin sells power transmission products, oil field pumping units, foundry castings and highway trailers wowrldwide.
